14: export function createProductReviews () {
15:   return async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
16:     const user = security.authenticatedUsers.from(req)
17:     challengeUtils.solveIf(
18:       challenges.forgedReviewChallenge,
19:       () => user?.data?.email !== req.body.author
20:     )
21: 
22:     try {
23:       await reviewsCollection.insert({
24:         product: req.params.id,
25:         message: req.body.message,
26:         author: req.body.author,
27:         likesCount: 0,
28:         likedBy: []
29:       })
30:       return res.status(201).json({ status: 'success' })
31:     } catch (err: unknown) {
32:       return res.status(500).json(utils.getErrorMessage(err))
33:     }
34:   }
35: }

6: import { type Request, type Response, type NextFunction } from 'express'
7: 
8: import * as challengeUtils from '../lib/challengeUtils'
9: import { challenges } from '../data/datacache'
10: import * as security from '../lib/insecurity'
11: import { UserModel } from '../models/user'
12: import * as utils from '../lib/utils'
13: import config from 'config'
14: 
15: export function updateUserProfile () {
16:   return async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
17:     const loggedInUser = security.authenticatedUsers.get(req.cookies.token)
18: 
19:     if (!loggedInUser) {
20:       next(new Error('Blocked illegal activity by ' + req.socket.remoteAddress))
21:       return
22:     }
23: 
24:     try {
25:       const user = await UserModel.findByPk(loggedInUser.data.id)
26:       if (!user) {
27:         next(new Error('User not found'))
28:         return
29:       }
30: 
31:       challengeUtils.solveIf(challenges.csrfChallenge, () => {
32:         const url = config.get<string>('challenges.overwriteUrlForCsrfChallenge')
33:         return ((req.headers.origin?.includes('://' + url.replace(/^https?:\/\//, ''))) ??
34:           (req.headers.referer?.includes('://' + url.replace(/^https?:\/\//, '')))) &&
35:           req.body.username !== user.username
36:       })
37: 
38:       const savedUser = await user.update({ username: req.body.username })
39:       const userWithStatus = utils.queryResultToJson(savedUser)
40:       const updatedToken = security.authorize(userWithStatus)
41:       security.authenticatedUsers.put(updatedToken, userWithStatus)
42:       res.cookie('token', updatedToken)
43:       res.location(process.env.BASE_PATH + '/profile')
44:       res.redirect(process.env.BASE_PATH + '/profile')
45:     } catch (error) {
46:       next(error)
47:     }
48:   }
49: }

177: // Recursively drops null-valued object keys and null array elements.
178: // custom configs use null to signal that a value from the default.yml should be overwritten
179: const dropNulls = (value: unknown): unknown => {
180:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
181:     return value.filter((entry) => entry != null).map(dropNulls)
182:   }
183:   if (value !== null && typeof value === 'object') {
184:     return Object.fromEntries(
185:       Object.entries(value)
186:         .filter(([, entry]) => entry != null)
187:         .map(([key, entry]) => [key, dropNulls(entry)])
188:     )
189:   }
190:   return value
191: }
